strings.name: Alex Ferguson
strings.summary: Alex Ferguson rose from Scottish football and early coaching to a long Manchester United tenure. At Aberdeen he challenged domestic dominance and won in Europe; at United he built sustained success through youth development, squad renewal and management. His United teams won 13 Premier League titles and two Champions Leagues, including the 1999 treble; he retired in 2013.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His long Manchester United tenure built a championship system and deeply influenced professional football management and youth development.
